args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Some notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Accounts may still show the old name.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.
- Please check any other saved reports or digests for the old Covey & Lark name before they go out.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia and Bettina
